author: Claude (Cowork), approved by ahmed 26 Oct ('YES, work hard to deliver it today', option 2: bigger fresh grading set)
purpose: Fresh grading/highlight evaluation of the learned ACES 2.0 model on footage never used by any ACES corpus, training run, development selection or gate (verified: 0 of 115 FXTD scene ids appear in any aces/run05/temporal/ambientcg corpus report or manifest). Replaces the 14-frame old_coherent grade set as the deciding evidence for grading; the frozen ambientCG prospective holdout stays untouched.
source: G:/datasets/corpora/rudra_run05_sources_20261022/sources.jsonl rows with licence_source == 'fxtd' (FXTD Studios own footage: RED Dragon linear EXR and ARRI LogC3, decoded to BT.2020 scene-linear, 1.0 = 203 nits, stored log2_extended PNG at 1920 wide). Per-frame metadata from rudra_fxtd_camera_20261016/_records.jsonl.
frame_selection: Per scene: frames whose record has no sensor_clipped_channels true and peak_at_ceiling false (reference must not be sensor-clipped); take the one with the median frame_index (lower median on ties). Scenes without an eligible frame are dropped. Order: sorted by scene_id.
processing: load_plate (rec2020) / (203/10000) -> scene units; area-downsample in linear light to longest side 512; BT.2020 -> AP1 (rudra.delivery.colorspace.convert). Reference = plate * 2**ev (ACEScg float32).
exposures: Two per frame, chosen only from the reference: ev such that the fraction of pixels whose max display code (ACES 2.0 SDR 100 nits, OCIO 2.5.2, cg-config-v4.0.0) is >= 254.5/255 equals 1% and 5% (bisection on ev in [-8, 12], 40 iterations).
inclusion: A (frame, exposure) case is kept if it has >= 100 highlight pixels (reconstruction_weight > 0 and max code > 0.5) after rendering. No other filtering, no look at any model output before freezing the case list.

candidates.primary: G:/rudra_training/partial_pcgrad_duration6400_retry1_20261025/step6400.pt (sha f73f14c7e74d5bb54d0cbf949b94365f2eeb12a3cc50ed3ea45d1ad1b163256e) with hybrid64 smoothing, constraint include_fully_clipped, forbid_new_negative_y

metrics: Per case on highlight pixels (w>0 & max code>0.5): display MSE in 8-bit codes^2 at -3, 0, +3 EV vs view.forward(reference*2**ev); asinh-RGB MSE vs reference (H); new negative AP1 luminance count; constraint remaining display errors. Means over cases (equal weight per case).
secondary_reporting: 95% bootstrap CI (10,000 resamples over scenes, seed 20261026) of model-minus-analytic for each metric; per-project breakdown (Manchale, Lab, ELMATAREED). Reported, not gates.
limits: Footage is the studio's own; three projects, two cameras; single frames, not video. Pass means numerical pass on this set only; visual review and release remain separate.
